column1: # An IFC2X3 export of Autodesk's rac_advanced_sample_project, in the three.js repository (MIT) at
# the one commit that touches it: examples/models/ifc/rac_advanced_sample_project.ifc, added by
# three.js pull request 20598 on 2021-03-30. An IFC2X3 Coordination View 2.0 export by Revit 2021
# (Spanish edition), file created 2021-01-22, exporter string "21.0.0.383 - Exporter 21.0.0.383 -
# IU alternativa 21.0.0.383", whose publisher is not established (RE-330 section 1). It shows the
# 2015 to 2020 state of the project: the 2015 to 2020 saves of the sample (research/autodesk-sample-projects.tsv)
# are scored against it by `-f racadv=true` (models racadv-2015 to racadv-2020), and it is counted
# apart as an IFC2X3 export everywhere: it can confirm a reader and never removes a value or decides
# a disagreement between Revit's exporters (standing rule, 2026-10-31).
# The file carries no licence of its own, the pull request says nothing of one, and Autodesk's terms
# for the sample it exports were not checked, so it is fetched for a run by
# tools/ci/fetch-rac-advanced-pair.sh from raw.githubusercontent.com, pinned by sha256 and byte
